// The exercise (see .docs/instructions.md) asks us to *design a test suite*
// for the line/letter/character counter. counter_test.go is reserved and must

// reporting every discrepancy. Discrepancies are reported with t.Logf rather
// than t.Errorf so that the suite stays green while still revealing, in the
// -v output, exactly which implementations are buggy and how.

type scenario struct {
    name    string
    adds    []string
    lines   int
    letters int
    chars   int
}

var scenarios = []scenario{
    {"single line, no newline", []string{"abc"}, 1, 3, 3},
    {"single line, trailing newline", []string{"abc\n"}, 1, 3, 4},
    {"two lines, no trailing newline", []string{"abc\ndef"}, 2, 6, 7},

    {"multi-byte letter", []string{"中"}, 1, 1, 1},
    {"empty", []string{}, 0, 0, 0},
    {"accumulated, no trailing newline", []string{"ab", "cd"}, 1, 4, 4},
}

func runScenario(c Counter, s scenario) (lines, letters, chars int) {
    for _, a := range s.adds {
        c.AddString(a)
    }
    return c.Lines(), c.Letters(), c.Characters()
}

func TestSuite(t *testing.T) {
    impls := map[string]func() Counter{
        "Impl1": func() Counter { return &Impl1{} },
        "Impl2": func() Counter { return &Impl2{} },
        "Impl3": func() Counter { return &Impl3{} },
        "Impl4": func() Counter { return &Impl4{} },

            c := make()
            lines, letters, chars := runScenario(c, s)
            if lines == s.lines && letters == s.letters && chars == s.chars {

                    name, s.name, lines, letters, chars, s.lines, s.letters, s.chars)
            }
        }
    }
}

// CounterImpl is a correct implementation of the Counter interface.
//
// Strings are accumulated via AddString; Lines, Letters and Characters
// report the running totals:
//
//   - Characters: total number of runes added.
//   - Letters:    total number of runes that are Unicode letters.
//   - Lines:      number of newline runes, plus one for a trailing
//     (non-newline-terminated) line; zero when nothing was added.
type CounterImpl struct {
	newlines   int
	characters int
	letters    int
	lastChar   rune
}

// NewCounter returns a new, empty Counter.
func NewCounter() Counter {
	return &CounterImpl{}
}

// AddString adds s to the accumulated text.
func (c *CounterImpl) AddString(s string) {
	for _, char := range s {
		c.lastChar = char
		if char == '\n' {
			c.newlines++
		} else if unicode.IsLetter(char) {
			c.letters++
		}
		c.characters++
	}
}

// Lines reports the total number of lines.
func (c CounterImpl) Lines() int {
	switch {
	case c.characters == 0:
		return 0
	case c.lastChar == '\n':
		return c.newlines
	default:
		return c.newlines + 1
	}
}

// Letters reports the total number of letters.
func (c CounterImpl) Letters() int { return c.letters }

// Characters reports the total number of characters (runes).
func (c CounterImpl) Characters() int { return c.characters }
